Position Description
   

  

 CGI is a global IT and business consulting services firm with a strong presence across industries and geographies. Our professionals collaborate with clients to deliver innovative, scalable technology solutions that drive meaningful business outcomes. At CGI, you'll be part of a collaborative, ownership\-driven culture where your ideas, expertise, and contributions help shape the future of technology.
   

  

 CGI is seeking an experienced and innovative Mid\-Level Full\-Stack AI Engineer to join our growing AI engineering team. In this role, you will lead the design, development, and deployment of scalable AI\-powered applications using modern full\-stack technologies, machine learning, and generative AI. You will play a key role in advancing CGI's AI Platform, developing intelligent solutions that integrate backend services, APIs, large language models (LLMs), data pipelines, and intuitive frontend experiences to address complex business challenges.
   

  

 This opportunity is ideal for a hands\-on engineer who thrives in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment and demonstrates strong technical ownership, problem\-solving capabilities, and a product\-focused mindset. You will work closely with cross\-functional teams to deliver production\-ready AI solutions, lead development of key features and client use cases, contribute to architectural decisions, and mentor junior engineers while promoting engineering excellence and continuous improvement.
   

  

 Location: This position may be based in any CGI office in the United States, with Knoxville, TN, as the preferred location.
   

  

 Your future duties and responsibilities
   

  

* Lead the design, development, and deployment of end\-to\-end AI\-powered applications, including backend services, APIs, data pipelines, model integrations, and user\-facing interfaces
* Architect, build, and maintain scalable, secure, and high\-performance backend services using Python and develop responsive frontend applications using Angular
* Design and implement generative AI, large language model (LLM), natural language processing (NLP), document classification, optical character recognition (OCR), and conversational AI solutions
* Lead machine learning model inference, training, fine\-tuning, and optimization efforts to deliver reliable, production\-ready AI capabilities
* Develop and optimize RESTful APIs, system integrations, and database solutions to support seamless interoperability, performance, and scalability across AI platform components
* Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines and containerized deployments using Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud technologies to support efficient and reliable software delivery
* Collaborate with product managers, data scientists, UI/UX designers, and engineering teams to translate business requirements into technical designs and high\-impact AI\-driven features
* Lead the technical development of client\-focused AI use cases leveraging CGI's AI Platform, driving assigned features from solution design through production deployment
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize production applications to ensure system availability, security, reliability, performance, and operational efficiency
* Mentor junior engineers, participate in architecture and design reviews, provide technical guidance, and champion software engineering best practices across the development lifecycle

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience
* 2\+ years of professional experience in full\-stack application development, with strong proficiency in Python for backend development and Angular for frontend development
* 2\+ years of hands\-on experience designing and developing AI\-powered products or solutions involving generative AI, NLP, document classification, chatbots, OCR, or related intelligent automation technologies
* Demonstrated experience with machine learning concepts, LLM inference, model integration, and the development and deployment of AI\-enabled applications
* Strong experience designing and developing RESTful APIs, integrating distributed application components, and applying software architecture and system design principles
* Hands\-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and container orchestration concepts, including deployment and management of applications in production environments
* Proficiency with relational and non\-relational databases, including database design, querying, performance tuning, and optimization techniques
* Experience leveraging cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform (GCP) to develop, deploy, manage, and scale AI applications
* Knowledge of secure software development practices, data privacy regulations, compliance requirements, and responsible AI principles
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills, with demonstrated ownership of technical deliverables, the ability to guide junior team members, and adaptability in a fast\-paced, evolving technology environment


**Desired Qualifications / Strongly Preferred**
* Experience developing production\-grade applications using LLM frameworks, orchestration libraries, or AI development tools such as LangChain, Hugging Face, or similar technologies
* Hands\-on experience implementing retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, embeddings, prompt engineering, or AI agent architectures
* Experience with model fine\-tuning, model evaluation, MLOps practices, and monitoring AI models in production environments
* Experience building and maintaining automated CI/CD pipelines, testing frameworks, and deployment workflows using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar tools
* Experience designing and deploying AI\-powered solutions using Microsoft Azure AI services, Google Cloud AI services, or related cloud\-native AI technologies
* Demonstrated experience leading technical feature development, mentoring engineers, contributing to architectural decisions, and delivering customer\-focused AI solutions

**Description**
 The Sable organization bridges the gap between the storage technologies offered by AWS and the features required to power Amazon's SDO (Stores, Digital, and Others) organization. Our primary offering, Sable, stores over 30 petabytes of critical Amazon data powering the Items and Offers Pipeline, Shopping Cart, Checkout, Retail \& Digital Ordering, Transportation Systems, and Fulfillment Systems. Sable serves over 150 million requests per second at sub\-millisecond latency, and is mission\-critical for Amazon's SDO: when it is unavailable, customer\-facing experiences and core business operations are directly impacted.
   

  

 The Sable Data Plane team is part of the Sable organization and focused on two key areas: the Sable Data Node and Disaster Recovery. We are a tier\-1 team operating some of the most critical storage infrastructure at Amazon, where correctness, durability, and availability are non\-negotiable.
   

  

 We are looking for a Software Development Engineer II to take full end\-to\-end ownership of Sable feature delivery and operational improvements. You will independently drive design, implementation, and rollout of changes to a tier\-1 system — advancing the platform without disrupting production traffic serving Amazon's most critical commerce flows.
   

  

 This is a role for an engineer who is energized by hard distributed\-systems problems and who takes genuine pride in operational reality: not just shipping good software, but ensuring that software holds up under the demands of a 30\+ PB, mission\-critical platform.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Work on deep, interesting storage problems at scale — anti\-entropy, leader election, disaster recovery, caching, replication, and data durability — strengthening the correctness and resilience of the Sable Data Node and its recovery paths.
* Take end\-to\-end ownership of Sable features and operational improvements — driving design, implementation, and safe rollout independently, without impacting production traffic.
* Carry on\-call responsibilities for tier\-1 services, acting as an active contributor during high\-severity operational incidents and driving mitigation and resolution with urgency.
* Conduct Root Cause Analysis for high\-severity incidents and author operational runbooks.
* When incidents reveal that Sable customers are not following best practices, advocate directly to those customers to adopt Sable's recommended patterns and configurations, preventing recurrence.
* Proactively identify and advocate for opportunities to improve operational excellence across the platform.
* Identify and make improvements to the team's development and testing practices, raising engineering quality.
* Mentor junior engineers and interns, helping to raise the overall bar of the team.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 1\+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
* 1\+ years of designing and developing large\-scale, multi\-tiered, multi\-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C\#, C\+\+, Java, or Perl experience
* 1\+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
* Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

**Description**
 A Forward Deployed Engineer II (FDE II) embeds directly inside a strategic enterprise customer to independently design, build, deploy, and run AI\-powered production systems alongside the customer's engineering team. FDE IIs write production\-grade software and own delivery of complete AI workstreams end\-to\-end — from requirements gathering through production deployment — combining the technical rigor of an AWS SDE with the urgency and ownership required to deliver measurable customer business outcomes.
   

  

 FDE IIs are autonomous contributors. They deliver working features spanning the full software lifecycle. They design cohesive implementations for ambiguous problems, making design trade\-offs with appropriate guidance. They take on projects where the business problem is understood but implementations are not fully fleshed out, balancing constraints and limiting short\-term workarounds. They coach others on producing high\-quality code and train new team members.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Embed within customer engineering teams. Work with customers, stakeholders, and peers to understand the business and customer value of the systems you build. Understand the customer's business processes, technical architecture, and operational constraints. Translate customer requirements into technical designs for AI\-enabled production systems within your workstream. Requires 30–50% travel.
   

  

 Build production AI applications. Design and develop production\-grade software powering AI and agentic workflows — retrieval pipelines, workflow automation, API orchestration layers, data integration. Solve difficult problems with visible risks or roadblocks, bringing clarity and identifying simple designs for solutions. Integrate foundation models, customer data sources, and existing applications into cohesive AI experiences. Optimize for latency, reliability, and cost.
   

  

 Own production for your workstream. Be a significant contributor to the full software development lifecycle including scoping, design, code, testing, deployment, operations, and maintenance. Troubleshoot production incidents across AI models, distributed systems, and application services. Ensure root causes of operational issues are identified and resolved. Implement monitoring, evaluations, guardrails, and CI/CD that keep AI systems healthy. Don't settle for the status quo — routinely identify and execute on opportunities to improve operations.
   

  

 Mentor and uplift. Actively mentors and trains new team members on how systems are constructed, operated, and fit into the bigger picture. Coach others on producing high\-quality code through mechanisms such as code review. Be active in the code review process, providing meaningful feedback to others.
   

  

 Accelerate customer adoption. Identify opportunities to expand AI adoption within your customer engagement. Codify reusable patterns and accelerators that benefit future customer deployments and feed back into AWS services. Make enhancements that improve your team's software and processes.

**About ElevenLabs**
 ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
   

  

 We launched in January 2023 with the first human\-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses \- from fast\-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B \- multiples of 11, always.
   

  

**We Have Expanded From Voice Into Three Main Platforms**
* ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
* ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70\+ languages.
* ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.


 Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team \- builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex\-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.
   

  

 How we work
   

  

* High\-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
* Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
* AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher\-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
* Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
* Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.


 What we offer
   

  

* Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
* Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact \- beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
* Learning \& development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
* Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
* Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location \- past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
* Co\-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co\-working stipend.


**About The Role**
 The Music team owns music and sound effects end to end at ElevenLabs. We turn research breakthroughs into APIs and creative tools, from the backend systems that bring in new models to the interfaces creators use inside ElevenCreative. Five new research engineers have just joined the music research group, and models for stem separation and MIDI transcription are in progress.
   

  

 You’ll join as a Full\-Stack Engineer with a backend lean. You’ll work with research and research engineering to bring model improvements into production, and build and run the APIs behind them. You’ll also sync with go\-to\-market to decide which features, including bespoke enterprise ones, get built next. Occasionally you’ll join customer calls when a customer wants someone technical.
   

  

 Engineers act as PMs. You’ll be handed ambiguous goals and expected to break them down. That means working through the legal questions, choosing the engineering approach, and planning the launch with growth. Models set the limits, so you’ll design systems that let a better model be swapped in later. Engineering is often only half the job.
   

  

**Requirements**
* A strong Full\-Stack Engineer with a backend lean. You’ve built and shipped production APIs and backend systems.
* A product decomposition mindset. You’ve taken a vague goal, weighed trade\-offs and shipped without analysis paralysis.
* Proactive ownership. You drive work end to end without a ticket board or someone assigning tasks.
* Comfortable working across research, legal, safety, growth, design and enterprise customers.
* Genuinely excited about music and AI. You’re the kind of person who prototypes ideas for fun and pushes the good ones into production.


 Bonus: music or audio experience (even as a hobby), or experience shipping ML models into production.
